dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: I can see that a great deal of thought was put in to the interior design of this space. They knew it'd be used as a temporary rest point, and made sure it was suited for that purpose.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Different areas with different functions to accommodate a range of visitors and interests... but a consistent theme with the choice of colors and furnishings — cozy and comfortable.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: I could really go for a cup of coffee right now.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Are you doing alright? Take it from me, if you're getting fatigued, do something else for a while, take your mind off things. You definitely wanna avoid making any major decisions while you're not in the right mental state.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Oh, don't get me wrong — I'm not suggesting you should give up. It was your choice to venture inside, so I'm sure you must want to fully explore it.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: A project of this scale is a real test of endurance. Gotta keep your head in the game. So do I.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: They say that every story reflects something about the writer's hopes and dreams. So reading the story gives you a window into the author's mind.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: The idea of my life story as a book... Yeah, not a fun read. No way...
